full_text: Woman is speech practice. The topic is a brave choice. Among all of the decisions I made in my life, I think one of the brave choice that I can think of is the time when I decided to move to other cities. It was in 2019 when I decided to get married and start over and go to a new city. I think that that moment is pretty scary because I've never been to that city before. I have no idea about what does it look like to live in that city. I don't even know what kind of jobs I'm going to end up with. But eventually, I made that decision because I believe that whenever there's a problem, there's always a solution for that. So that's one of the decisions that I make that I can think of is quite, I will call it challenging. But now, if I look back, I'm very grateful for the decision that I made. I decided to move to other city and start a new life with someone that I love, and I really enjoy everything that we have done together. A brave decision for me is something that I decided to move and start over.
